description.short_caption: Extensive ulcerations on the lower leg and foot with exposed dermis.
description.detailed_description: This clinical photograph shows the lower leg and foot of a patient with multiple large, irregularly shaped ulcerations. The ulcers have well-demarcated borders and expose the underlying dermis, which appears red and moist. Surrounding skin is hyperpigmented, with some areas showing mild swelling. The foot is partially submerged in water, suggesting a possible wound care or soaking procedure. The ulcers are located on the anterior lower leg and dorsum of the foot.
